headline: Man electrocuted while trying to steal transformer in Magura
summary: A 25-year-old man died early today after allegedly attempting to steal an electrical transformer in Magura Sadar upazila.
details: A 25-year-old man, identified as Firoz Biswas, died from electrocution early today in Magura Sadar upazila.
The incident occurred in Chandpur Paschimpara village, where police recovered the body from beneath a rural electricity pole beside a road.
According to police and local residents, Biswas was allegedly attempting to steal a transformer installed on the electricity pole when the accident happened.
Police found tools believed to have been used in the attempted theft at the scene.
The body has been sent to the morgue of Magura Sadar Hospital for an autopsy.
caption:
A 25-year-old man was electrocuted to death while allegedly trying to steal a transformer in Magura.

A 25-year-old man, identified as Firoz Biswas, died from electrocution early today in Magura Sadar upazila.

The incident occurred in Chandpur Paschimpara village, where police recovered the body from beneath a rural electricity pole beside a road.

According to police and local residents, Biswas was allegedly attempting to steal a transformer installed on the electricity pole when the accident happened.

Police found tools believed to have been used in the attempted theft at the scene.

The body has been sent to the morgue of Magura Sadar Hospital for an autopsy.

headline_marked: Father [[arrested for killing daughter]] and dumping body in sack
headline: Father arrested for killing daughter and dumping body in sack
summary: A 40-year-old man was captured by RAB and police in Khulna after 10 days of evasion following the murder of his 16-year-old daughter.
details: A joint operation by RAB and police led to the arrest of Alim Hossain, alias Akash, in the Dumuria Bazar area of Khulna. He is the primary suspect in the murder of his 16-year-old daughter, Arfana Hossain Nirjana.

The victim, a class 10 student at Government Iqbal Nagar Secondary School, was killed on July 8 during an argument with her parents. Police report that the mother beat her, and the father subsequently struck her on the head with a wooden plank, causing her death.

To hide the evidence, the father placed the body in a plastic sack used for carrying pigeon feed and transported it by motorcycle to the Prantika Residential Area of Khulna Sadar. He dumped the body on Road 3 of the residential area before fleeing.

The body was discovered by police, but since the victim was initially unidentified, a case was filed against unknown suspects. The investigation progressed after the mother, Arifa Yasmin, identified the body and later confessed to her involvement in the crime.

According to police, the conflict arose because Arfana had married of her own volition and wanted to return to her husband, which her parents opposed. Police also noted that both parents are drug addicts.
Alim Hossain had been evading capture by frequently changing his location. He was arrested on Saturday afternoon at a tea stall and will be produced in court on Sunday.
